correctness.rationale: For arbitrary nonempty W, every positive row superlevel set finite forces each sup-min value to achieve its maximum on a finite cut. An infinite positive cut yields an explicit strictly increasing nonattained supremum under a single atomic valuation. The exact finite-truncation sup error is the tail supremum, attained with 0 on retained coordinates and 1 outside. Hence uniform finite truncation and product continuity are equivalent to the finite-cut condition; discontinuity at zero proves necessity. Universal inf-residuum attainment holds exactly for finite positive support, with an explicit nonattained zero-infimum atomic valuation for infinite support. The decaying star separates them. The packaged checker exhaustively reproduces all discrete-grid cases through four coordinates and finite-stage witnesses; it does not substitute for infinite proofs.

originality.rationale: No covering fixed-frame theorem was found in the inspected 2011, 2022, 2025, and 2026 primary texts or in the actual semantic database queries. The contribution is the five-fold universal possibility witnessing/finite-superlevel/product-continuity/uniform-truncation equivalence with an exact sharp truncation modulus, and a strict contrast with universal necessity witnessing. Basic sup-min semantics, finite branching, and the notion of witnessed models are prior art. Full historical priority is not certified, especially in the older fuzzy aggregation literature.
residual_risks: A theorem in general max-min relation theory, Sugeno/possibility integration or lattice aggregation might imply the operator equivalence or truncation estimate without Gödel-modal terminology; a plausible 2011 general operator source was accessible only as abstract.
Not all historical or unpublished literature can be excluded; negative searches are not a uniqueness certificate.
The exact truncation identity itself is elementary; the asserted contribution is the coupled one-sided modal witnessing/continuity/approximation classification and strict box contrast.

value.rationale: Partly witnessed Gödel-modal semantics motivates a fixed-frame question: when are all possibility subformula suprema attained for all valuations on possibly infinite fuzzy frames? The answer is the natural vanishing-at-infinity condition, strictly broader than finite branching. Its exact sharp tail-supremum truncation modulus gives concrete uniform finite approximations, while product continuity supplies a topological characterization. The opposing box criterion reveals a genuine one-sided structural boundary. This is a motivated complete characterization, not a parameter tweak or a finite enumeration.
